sign.aries.name: Aries
sign.aries.strength: You start things nobody else dares to.
sign.aries.watch: You can mistake speed for progress.
sign.aries.take: Main character energy, no warm-up needed. Just remember other people are not extras.
sign.aries.flavor.0: Your impatience is really a compass today, it points at what you actually want.
sign.aries.flavor.1: Say the bold thing first. The polite version can follow.
sign.aries.flavor.2: Your fire is loud right now, so aim it at one target instead of five.
sign.aries.flavor.3: A small win before lunch changes your whole mood. Go get it.
sign.aries.flavor.4: You do not need permission. You may need a snack, though.
sign.aries.flavor.5: Pause for one breath before you hit send. Then send it.
sign.taurus.name: Taurus
sign.taurus.strength: You make everything around you feel safe.
sign.taurus.watch: Comfort can quietly turn into a rut.
sign.taurus.take: You are the friend with the good blanket and the better opinions. Please also try new things.
sign.taurus.flavor.0: Slow is not behind. Slow is how you get it right today.
sign.taurus.flavor.1: Treat yourself to something that actually feels good, not just looks good.
sign.taurus.flavor.2: Your patience is winning an argument you have not even started.
sign.taurus.flavor.3: Trust your gut about money and people, it has a very good track record.
sign.taurus.flavor.4: Change one tiny habit today and watch how fast the world notices.
sign.taurus.flavor.5: You are allowed to want more than "fine".
sign.gemini.name: Gemini
sign.gemini.strength: You can talk to anyone and learn from everyone.
sign.gemini.watch: You scatter your energy across ten tabs.
sign.gemini.take: Your brain has fifteen tabs open and every single one is a banger. Close two.
sign.gemini.flavor.0: Your words land harder than usual today, so use them kindly.
sign.gemini.flavor.1: Finish the thing you started on Monday before you start a new one.
sign.gemini.flavor.2: A conversation with a stranger gives you the missing piece.
sign.gemini.flavor.3: Two choices feel equal. Flip a coin, then notice what you hope for.
sign.gemini.flavor.4: You are funnier when you are honest. Try it on someone you like.
sign.gemini.flavor.5: Your curiosity is a superpower, not a distraction. Feed it on purpose.
sign.cancer.name: Cancer
sign.cancer.strength: You feel what a room needs before anyone says it.
sign.cancer.watch: You absorb moods that are not yours.
sign.cancer.take: You are everybody's therapist and nobody's emergency contact. Fix that.
sign.cancer.flavor.0: Your intuition is loud today. Believe the first feeling, not the third.
sign.cancer.flavor.1: Home, in any form, is the reset button. Go press it.
sign.cancer.flavor.2: You can love someone and still say no to them.
sign.cancer.flavor.3: Not every mood in the room belongs to you. Hand a few back.
sign.cancer.flavor.4: A soft boundary is still a boundary. Draw one today.
sign.cancer.flavor.5: Cook, text a friend, light a candle. Small rituals fix big days.
sign.leo.name: Leo
sign.leo.strength: You light up any space you walk into.
sign.leo.watch: You can need the spotlight a little too much.
sign.leo.take: You are the party, honey, but let somebody else pick one song.
sign.leo.flavor.0: You shine brightest today when you hype someone else up.
sign.leo.flavor.1: Take the stage, but check who built it first.
sign.leo.flavor.2: Pride is fine. Defensive pride is expensive. Choose the first one.
sign.leo.flavor.3: Your generosity gets noticed, even when you wish it would not.
sign.leo.flavor.4: Do something a little dramatic. It suits you and it is good for morale.
sign.leo.flavor.5: Ask for the thing you want out loud, in full sentences.
sign.virgo.name: Virgo
sign.virgo.strength: You notice the detail that saves the whole plan.
sign.virgo.watch: You grade yourself harder than anyone else would.
sign.virgo.take: You fix everyone's life in your head and forget to book your own dentist.
sign.virgo.flavor.0: Your standards are high today. Aim them at the work, not at yourself.
sign.virgo.flavor.1: Make the list, then cross off just three things. That counts.
sign.virgo.flavor.2: A tiny improvement now saves you a headache next week.
sign.virgo.flavor.3: You are allowed to be proud before it is perfect.
sign.virgo.flavor.4: Help someone today, then let them thank you without waving it away.
sign.virgo.flavor.5: Clean one drawer, clear one thought. It is the same drawer.
sign.libra.name: Libra
sign.libra.watch: You avoid hard talks to keep things pretty.
sign.libra.take: You will plan the entire outfit for a conversation you are avoiding. Have the conversation.
sign.libra.flavor.0: Today asks you to choose, not to weigh options forever.
sign.libra.flavor.1: Beauty helps. Rearrange something around you and notice your mood shift.
sign.libra.flavor.2: Fair does not mean you give in. It means you say it kindly and mean it.
sign.libra.flavor.3: Someone wants your honest opinion, not your diplomatic one.
sign.libra.flavor.4: You attract what you are calm about. Stay calm.
sign.libra.flavor.5: Say yes to the invitation you were about to talk yourself out of.
sign.scorpio.name: Scorpio
sign.scorpio.strength: You see through everything and still stay.
sign.scorpio.watch: You test people instead of just asking them.
sign.scorpio.take: You read minds for fun and then wonder why nobody tells you things. They are scared, babe.
sign.scorpio.flavor.0: Your instincts are sharp. Ask the question you keep rehearsing.
sign.scorpio.flavor.1: Not everything is a secret. Let one thing be simple today.
sign.scorpio.flavor.2: Transformation is quiet today: you drop something you outgrew.
sign.scorpio.flavor.3: You do not have to test someone to know if they care. Ask.
sign.scorpio.flavor.4: Your focus is a laser. Point it at something you love.
sign.scorpio.flavor.5: Let one person in a little further, just to see what happens.
sign.sagittarius.name: Sagittarius
sign.sagittarius.strength: You make the world feel bigger and the day lighter.
sign.sagittarius.watch: You say the true thing before checking the room.
sign.sagittarius.take: You promised three people a trip and you meant all three. Pick one, buy the tickets.
sign.sagittarius.flavor.0: A new idea has legs today. Take it for a short walk.
sign.sagittarius.flavor.1: Honesty is your charm, but add a little timing.
sign.sagittarius.flavor.2: Say yes to something that scares you a bit and thrills you more.
sign.sagittarius.flavor.3: Your optimism is not naive, it is a plan with good lighting.
sign.sagittarius.flavor.4: Look up, literally. The sky is giving you a hint.
sign.sagittarius.flavor.5: Commit to one thing for one week. You will surprise yourself.
sign.capricorn.name: Capricorn
sign.capricorn.strength: You build things that are still standing years later.
sign.capricorn.watch: You treat rest as something to earn.
sign.capricorn.take: You schedule fun like a meeting and honestly it works. Please also be late to something.
sign.capricorn.flavor.0: Progress is quiet today, and it still counts.
sign.capricorn.flavor.1: You are the plan. Trust your own competence.
sign.capricorn.flavor.2: Rest is not a reward, it is part of the job. Clock out on time.
sign.capricorn.flavor.3: Someone needs you to be soft today, not impressive.
sign.capricorn.flavor.4: A slow, serious yes beats a fast, fuzzy maybe.
sign.capricorn.flavor.5: Call back the person you keep "meaning" to call.
sign.aquarius.name: Aquarius
sign.aquarius.strength: You think of what the rest of us need before we do.
sign.aquarius.watch: You keep people at arm's length and call it independence.
sign.aquarius.take: You care about humanity in bulk and forget to text your actual friends. Text one now.
sign.aquarius.flavor.0: Your weird idea is the good one. Say it out loud.
sign.aquarius.flavor.1: Connection beats cleverness today. Be a little less clever.
sign.aquarius.flavor.2: You are allowed to need people. It does not make you less free.
sign.aquarius.flavor.3: Join the group chat, the club, the thing. You are better in a crowd than you admit.
sign.aquarius.flavor.4: Detach from the noise for an hour and watch your best thought arrive.
sign.aquarius.flavor.5: Do one kind, ordinary thing for someone you will never need anything from.
sign.pisces.name: Pisces
sign.pisces.strength: You feel the world in color and make others feel it too.
sign.pisces.watch: You escape into fantasy when real life gets loud.
sign.pisces.take: You are so empathetic you cry at ads. It is not a flaw, but please eat lunch.
sign.pisces.flavor.0: Your dreams are talking. Write down the one you remember.
sign.pisces.flavor.1: Create something small and imperfect. That is how it starts.
sign.pisces.flavor.2: Not every sadness is yours to carry. Put one down.
sign.pisces.flavor.3: Your softness is a strength, so protect it with a firm boundary.
sign.pisces.flavor.4: Music, water, a long walk. Your answer is in there.
sign.pisces.flavor.5: Tell the truth gently. It lands better than the pretty lie.

hs.love.3: Someone close to you needs reassurance more than a perfect answer.
hs.love.4: A crush could turn into real conversation if you are curious about them.
hs.love.5: If you are partnered, plan one small thing just for the two of you.
hs.love.6: Today you attract what you are calm about. Stay calm.
hs.love.7: A little vulnerability goes a very long way today.
hs.love.8: Do not read minds. Ask, kindly, and believe the answer.
hs.love.9: An old feeling returns for a moment. You can say hello and keep walking.
hs.love.10: The right person does not make you work for basic kindness.
hs.love.11: Flirt with your whole self, not just the polished version.
hs.love.12: You may hear something that clears up a mixed signal.
hs.love.13: A friend counts as love today. Tell them.

hs.love.17: Let someone take care of you for once, and do not apologize.

hs.love.19: A conversation at the end of the day matters more than the whole week.
hs.love.20: Self-love is the flirt of the day, so dress for yourself.
hs.love.21: Do not chase an answer. A clear no is also a gift.
hs.love.22: Be generous with compliments, they come back to you.
hs.love.23: A new connection moves a little fast. Enjoy it, and keep your feet on the ground.

hs.love.25: Be as clear about what you want as you are about what you do not.

hs.love.27: Someone is thinking about you more than they have admitted.

hs.love.29: Choose the person who makes your shoulders drop.
hs.love.30: A good laugh is the best chemistry test today.
hs.love.31: Healing is not linear, and you are doing better than you think.
hs.love.32: A date, a call, or a note: the effort is the romance.
hs.love.33: The best love story today is how you treat yourself.
hs.love.34: If you are single, notice who you are when you are not looking.
hs.love.35: Do not shrink your feelings to keep someone comfortable.
hs.career.0: At work, clear communication beats clever strategy today.
hs.career.1: Your ideas are good, so say them early in the meeting.
hs.career.2: Finish the task you have been postponing. It is smaller than your dread.
hs.career.3: A colleague notices something you did well, so let them say it.
hs.career.4: A new skill or tool pays off sooner than you expect.
hs.career.5: Ask for the feedback you are afraid of, it is the shortcut.
hs.career.6: A calm, specific "no" protects your best work today.
hs.career.7: Teamwork shines. Share the credit and you will get more of it.
hs.career.8: A boring task hides something useful, so look closer.
hs.career.9: Your reputation grows quietly through small, reliable actions.
hs.career.10: It is a good time to update your portfolio, CV or profile.
hs.career.11: A problem has a simple fix, and you are the one who can see it.
hs.career.12: Do not answer every message today. Protect two focused hours.
hs.career.13: A mentor figure appears, in person or on a screen.
hs.career.14: Organize your week and you will find a surprising amount of free time.
hs.career.15: Say yes to the stretch assignment, then ask for support.
hs.career.16: You are more qualified than your inner critic claims.
hs.career.17: Make the call, send the email, hit publish. Done beats perfect.
hs.career.18: Someone senior pays attention to your effort. Keep going.
hs.career.19: Today is better for building than for pitching.
hs.career.20: A clear deadline helps you focus, so set one for yourself.
hs.career.21: A small change in routine unlocks a lot of energy.
hs.career.22: Rest counts as work today, so take your lunch break.
hs.career.23: Negotiate gently. The calmest voice in the room usually wins.
hs.career.24: The project you doubted shows a hopeful sign.
hs.career.25: A tricky colleague softens when you are direct and polite.
hs.career.26: Learn one new thing today and tell someone about it.
hs.career.27: Your steady pace beats everyone else's sprint this week.
hs.career.28: Be the person who makes the next step obvious.
hs.career.29: A side project deserves 30 minutes of attention today.
hs.career.30: Prepare more than you think you need, and speak less than you planned.
hs.career.31: You do not have to be the loudest to be the most trusted.
hs.career.32: A boundary around your time makes your work better.
hs.career.33: A good decision at work starts with a good night of sleep.
hs.career.34: Look for the person who needs one small yes from you.
hs.career.35: Collaborate with the colleague you usually avoid, it surprises you.
hs.money.0: Money likes a plan, so write one number down today.
hs.money.1: A small saving habit starts feeling normal this week.
hs.money.2: Do not buy it at 11 pm. Add it to the cart and sleep on it.
hs.money.3: An unexpected expense is smaller than it looks, so breathe.
hs.money.4: A smart swap saves you more than a sacrifice would.
hs.money.5: Check subscriptions you forgot, there is a quiet win in there.
hs.money.6: Spend on something that makes your daily life smoother, not just prettier.
hs.money.7: Talk about money with someone you trust, it takes the fear out.
hs.money.8: A modest, steady choice beats a flashy shortcut.
hs.money.9: Value yourself in your next negotiation, and say the number first.
hs.money.10: Plan the big purchase now so you can enjoy it later.
hs.money.11: Treat yourself a little, on purpose and within your budget.
hs.money.12: A generous gesture to a friend returns in another form.
hs.money.13: Look at the long game: small amounts, repeated, win.
hs.money.14: Today is good for organizing bills, receipts or goals.
hs.money.15: Compare two options before you commit, the difference is real.
hs.money.16: Be careful with promises about money, yours and other people's.
hs.money.17: Your sense of value is sharp, so trust it when you shop.
hs.money.18: A chance to earn a little extra shows up, so say yes if it is fair.
hs.money.19: Wanting more is not greedy. Planning for it is wise.
hs.money.20: Skip the impulse buy and let the want pass. It usually does.
hs.money.21: Invest in your skills, they are the asset that cannot be taken away.
hs.money.22: Pay what you owe, big or small. It lightens your whole day.
hs.money.23: A deal that sounds perfect deserves a second look.
hs.money.24: Your relationship with money is improving, so keep going.
hs.money.25: Set one tiny financial goal and celebrate when you hit it.
hs.money.26: Comfort and security feel good together, so budget for both.
hs.money.27: Share a cost with someone and keep it fair and clear.
hs.money.28: Today it is smarter to wait than to chase.
hs.money.29: A little extra buffer calms your whole nervous system.
hs.energy.0: Drink water, step outside, and stretch your neck. Seriously.
hs.energy.1: Your body asks for slower mornings and earlier nights.
hs.energy.2: A 10-minute walk fixes more than you expect.
hs.energy.3: Eat something warm and comforting, it is not a reward, it is fuel.
hs.energy.4: Take a screen break and let your eyes rest on something far away.
hs.energy.5: Your mood follows your sleep, so protect it tonight.
hs.energy.6: Try one deep breath before every reply today.
hs.energy.7: Put your phone in another room for an hour. Notice what you feel.
hs.energy.8: Music is medicine today, so build a mood playlist.
hs.energy.9: Move your body in a way that is fun, not punishing.
hs.energy.10: Tidy one small space and notice your mind tidy too.
hs.energy.11: Take a shower, change your clothes, reset the vibe.
hs.energy.12: Say no to one thing that drains you, kindly and quickly.
hs.energy.13: Your energy dips mid-afternoon, so plan a snack and a pause.
hs.energy.14: Spend ten minutes in the sun if you can find it.
hs.energy.15: Write down three things that went right, even tiny ones.
hs.energy.16: Call someone who makes you laugh, it counts as self-care.
hs.energy.17: Light a candle, open a window, take a minute for yourself.
hs.energy.18: Your nervous system likes routine, so keep one small ritual today.
hs.energy.19: Slow down your last hour before bed and sleep will thank you.
hs.energy.20: Stand up, shake out your shoulders, and take your own advice.
hs.energy.21: Be patient with yourself, you are doing a lot.
hs.energy.22: Fresh air, slow breath, and a phone-free walk. That is the prescription.
hs.energy.23: Say something kind to yourself, out loud, in the mirror.
hs.energy.24: Take your time with a meal and actually taste it.
hs.energy.25: Listen to your body, it speaks quietly and does not lie.
hs.energy.26: Do one thing today only because it feels nice.
hs.energy.27: Hydrate, then do the thing you are avoiding.
hs.energy.28: Rest is productive. Put that on a sticky note.
hs.energy.29: Ground yourself: feet on the floor, shoulders down, jaw loose.
hs.advice.0: Tonight's mantra: I can do this at my own pace.
hs.advice.1: Today, choose the option that makes you feel more like yourself.
hs.advice.2: If you are unsure, take the kinder path and the longer breath.
hs.advice.3: Say yes to the thing that scares and excites you equally.
hs.advice.4: Do not explain yourself to people who are committed to misunderstanding you.
hs.advice.5: The next small step is enough. You do not need the whole staircase.
hs.advice.6: Be gentle with the version of you that is still learning.
hs.advice.7: You can be soft and strong in the same sentence.
hs.advice.8: Protect your peace like it is your favorite person.
hs.advice.9: A good ending is also a beginning, so close the tab and move on.
hs.advice.10: Your timing is not late. It is yours.
hs.advice.11: Choose progress over perfect, and do it before dinner.
hs.advice.12: Ask for what you need in one clear sentence.
hs.advice.13: You are not too much. You are in the wrong room.
hs.advice.14: Let the compliment in. All the way in.
hs.advice.15: Make a tiny plan, then loosen your grip on it.
hs.advice.16: Someone is learning from how you handle today. Handle it well.
hs.advice.17: Trust what you feel, then check it with what you know.
hs.advice.18: You do not need to win the argument to keep your peace.
hs.advice.19: Look for the lesson, then drop the guilt.
hs.advice.20: Your best decision today starts with a glass of water.
hs.advice.21: Do one thing that your future self will quietly thank you for.
hs.advice.22: Let people surprise you in a good way.
hs.advice.23: You are allowed to change your mind, and your plans, and your hair.
hs.advice.24: Be proud of one small thing before you go to bed.
hs.advice.25: Keep what feels like home, and let the rest go.
hs.advice.26: Use your voice, it is the only one that sounds like you.
hs.advice.27: You do not have to figure it all out tonight.
hs.advice.28: Make room for joy. It rarely arrives by appointment.
hs.advice.29: Go easy on the shoulds and heavy on the wants.
hs.advice.30: Notice how far you have come before you plan the next step.
hs.advice.31: When in doubt, be kind, then be clear.
hs.advice.32: A moment of stillness is a perfectly good answer.
hs.advice.33: Believe in the version of events where it works out.
hs.advice.34: You are more ready than the voice in your head admits.
hs.advice.35: Close the day by naming one thing you are grateful for.
compat.air_air.love: You talk for hours and flirt with ideas. Keep it light, but remember to say the feelings out loud too.
compat.air_air.friend: The funniest duo. You trade jokes, links and plans, and never run out of topics.
compat.air_air.work: Brilliant brainstorming. Assign one of you to finish things, and you are unstoppable.
compat.air_earth.love: Air wants freedom, earth wants stability. You teach each other how to fly and how to land.
compat.air_earth.friend: One dreams it up, the other makes it real. It works if you appreciate the difference.
compat.air_earth.work: A great pair. Air brings the vision, earth brings the schedule and the follow-through.
compat.air_fire.love: Playful, exciting, and a little dramatic in the best way. Air fans the fire, and fire lights up air.
compat.air_fire.friend: You make every plan sound like an adventure. Just do not forget to rest.
compat.air_fire.work: Fast, creative and fearless. You launch quickly, so assign someone to check the details.
compat.air_water.sum: Head and heart, learning each other.
compat.air_water.love: Water feels, air thinks. It works when you translate for each other instead of arguing about who is right.
compat.air_water.friend: You balance each other if you are patient. One calms the other when things get heavy.
compat.air_water.work: Logic plus intuition is powerful, as long as both are heard.
compat.earth_earth.love: A steady, sensual match that builds a real life together. Watch out for routines that get too cozy.
compat.earth_earth.friend: The friends who show up with food and a plan. You are safe and reliable for each other.
compat.earth_earth.work: Dependable and efficient. Nothing falls apart on your watch, so add a little risk now and then.
compat.earth_fire.love: Different speeds, strong attraction. Fire pushes, earth holds. Respect both rhythms.
compat.earth_fire.friend: Fun, if fire lets earth pick the restaurant and earth lets fire pick the plan.
compat.earth_fire.work: Fire starts, earth finishes. Great results when the roles are clear.
compat.earth_water.love: Deeply caring and very stable. Earth gives water a home, and water gives earth feeling and softness.
compat.earth_water.friend: Comforting and loyal. You make each other feel safe enough to be honest.
compat.earth_water.work: Quietly powerful. You build slowly and well, and you trust each other.
compat.fire_fire.love: Passion for days, and a few dramatic debates. Take turns being the spark and the calm.
compat.fire_fire.friend: You hype each other up and never get bored. Share the spotlight and it works.
compat.fire_fire.work: High energy and great ideas. Name who leads, or you will both try to.
compat.fire_water.love: Intense, emotional, magnetic. Fire can feel too hot for water, so use kind words and let it cool.
compat.fire_water.friend: It takes patience, but the bond is deep. Water softens fire, fire inspires water.
compat.fire_water.work: Passion meets intuition. Keep communication clear and you create something special.
compat.water_water.love: Tender, intuitive and deep. You feel each other without words, so make sure to say them anyway.
compat.water_water.friend: You are the friends who text at 2 am and know exactly why. Do not drown in each other's moods.
compat.water_water.work: Sensitive and creative. Great for caring work, and stronger when someone sets the schedule.
compat.opp: Opposite signs: strong pull, strong lessons.
compat.same: Same sign: you mirror each other, for better and for worse.

moon.tip.1: Take the first small step toward it.
moon.tip.2: Decide, and push through the wobble.
moon.tip.4: Feelings run high. Celebrate, and let go of one thing.
moon.tip.6: Release a habit that no longer helps.
moon.tip.7: Rest, recover and get ready to begin again.

astro.moonsign.3: The Moon in Cancer is tender and protective. Home, family and soft routines feel important.
astro.moonsign.4: The Moon in Leo wants warmth and applause. Be generous, play, and let yourself shine.
astro.moonsign.5: The Moon in Virgo likes order. Tidy, plan, fix the small things that have been nagging you.
astro.moonsign.6: The Moon in Libra seeks balance. Beauty, fairness and good company soothe you today.
astro.moonsign.7: The Moon in Scorpio feels everything deeply. Honest talks and private reflection go far.
astro.moonsign.8: The Moon in Sagittarius is restless and hopeful. Say yes to a little adventure or a big idea.
astro.moonsign.9: The Moon in Capricorn is focused and serious. Progress on a long goal feels satisfying.
astro.moonsign.10: The Moon in Aquarius is independent and inventive. Try something different, connect with your people.
astro.moonsign.11: The Moon in Pisces is dreamy and intuitive. Rest, create, and listen to your inner voice.
astro.house.tip.0: Your own needs come first today. Notice how you feel before you decide.
astro.house.tip.1: A good day to look at your money, your worth and what you really value.
astro.house.tip.2: Conversations, messages and short trips are favored. Say what you mean.
astro.house.tip.3: Your private space matters. Family and home are where you recharge.
astro.house.tip.4: Fun, flirting and creativity are favored. Do something purely for joy.
astro.house.tip.5: Routines, health and the daily grind need a little care. Small fixes help.
astro.house.tip.6: Other people take the stage: a partner, a close friend, a deal. Listen well.
astro.house.tip.7: Deep feelings and shared resources come up. Trust and honesty are the theme.
astro.house.tip.8: Your mind wants to roam: travel, study, big questions. Widen your view.
astro.house.tip.9: Your public life is in focus. Work and reputation respond to steady effort.
astro.house.tip.10: Friends, groups and your hopes for the future take center stage.
astro.house.tip.11: A quiet day for rest, dreams and closing loops. Do not push.
astro.sky.sub: Real positions today. Your sign is at the top.
astro.mercury.retro: Mercury is retrograde. Double-check messages, back things up and avoid signing in a rush.
astro.mercury.direct: Mercury moves forward. Clear communication, easy plans and good timing for talks.
astro.venus.good: Venus warms your heart today. Affection and charm come easily.
astro.venus.tense: Venus is a little edgy. Watch for touchy moods and say things softly.
astro.venus.conj: Venus sits in your sign: you are extra magnetic today.
astro.venus.none: Venus is neutral. Love runs on ordinary kindness today.
astro.mars.good: Mars gives you drive. Start the thing you have been putting off.
astro.mars.tense: Mars is prickly. Pace yourself and pick your battles.
astro.mars.conj: Mars sits in your sign: lots of fire, so aim it well.
astro.mars.none: Mars is steady. Energy is average, and that is perfectly fine.
astro.mercury.good: Mercury sharpens your mind. A good day for talks and decisions.
astro.mercury.tense: Mercury is tangled. Reread before you send, and slow down.
astro.mercury.conj: Mercury is in your sign: your words carry extra weight.
astro.mercury.none: Mercury is calm. Ordinary communication, no drama.
astro.jupiter.good: Jupiter brings luck and generosity. Say yes to a fair opportunity.
astro.jupiter.tense: Jupiter urges you to overdo it. Enjoy, but keep a budget.
astro.jupiter.conj: Jupiter is in your sign: a lucky stretch, so think big.
astro.jupiter.none: Jupiter is in the background. Growth is slow and steady.
astro.saturn.good: Saturn rewards discipline. Steady work now pays off later.
astro.saturn.tense: Saturn tests your patience. Hard work is not wasted.
astro.saturn.conj: Saturn is in your sign: a serious period that builds real strength.
astro.saturn.none: Saturn is quiet. Keep your routines and keep going.
